reviews.title: I left my paper planner for Artful Agenda
reviews.text:
Artful Agenda is hands down one of the best planning apps I have ever used. I was a dedicated paper planner person, and this is the app that finally made me leave my paper planner behind. That says a lot, because I loved the creativity and routine of planning on paper.

What completely won me over is how easy Artful Agenda is to use across all of my devices. I can quickly check or update something on my iPhone, sit down with my iPad when I want to plan and decorate, and open everything on my MacBook when I’m working or doing schoolwork. Having the same planner available wherever I am makes staying organized so much easier.

I use Artful Agenda for everything — work, school, assignments, exams, appointments, bills, travel, routines, reminders, and everyday life. Even when my schedule is packed, it helps me see everything clearly in one place without feeling overwhelming.

The customization is also a huge reason I love it. I can use stickers, change colors, decorate my pages, and make each week or month feel completely different. It gives me everything I loved about paper planning, but with the convenience of being digital. No carrying around a bulky planner, no erasing plans when something changes, and no worrying about leaving it at home.

The app is beautiful, intuitive, functional, and fun. I’ve tried other planners and calendar apps, but Artful Agenda is the one I actually enjoy opening and using every day.

If you love planning but want something that works seamlessly with a busy life, I genuinely cannot recommend Artful Agenda enough. I left my paper planner for this app, and I have no desire to go back.

Five stars without hesitation! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.text:
I’ve tried so many different planners and planning systems, and Artful Agenda is the first one that gives me the organization of a digital calendar while still feeling like the paper planner I love. Being able to sync my Google Calendar and see my appointments, kids’ activities, work, tasks, meals, and personal life all in one beautiful place has been a game changer.

I especially love being able to color-code everything, customize the look of my planner, create lists and tasks, and still have that satisfying “planner” experience without having to maintain both a paper planner and a digital calendar.

As a busy mom juggling kids, school activities, work, a business, appointments, and everything else life throws at us, Artful Agenda helps me feel like I can actually see my entire week and stay on top of it.

There are always features I’d love to see added in the future—especially more advanced time blocking and smart task scheduling—but overall, this is easily my favorite planning app I’ve used. Highly recommend it for anyone who loves paper planners but needs the convenience of digital!

Personally, I can’t even get past the free trial page. I wanted to explore the app first and then decide, but I don’t see any option to let me, so I would have to start the trial to access the app.

reviews.title: Good app for neurodivergent needs
reviews.text:
If you need the rigidness of a schedule and to plan things out, but also need the flexibility to move things around while you plan, this is a good planner app for that.
I will say that I hate subscriptions of any kind and if it’s too high of a sub it’ll be sad to see a feature go, but I’m okay with the price for now.
I like that I can pencil in my events and have them linked to any and all my other emails and devices.
I like that I can write out potential plans and move them around if need be, to pre plan events in the way I need before setting them in, that’s my favorite thing about this app.
The stickers and themes are cute and give me dopamine. (You can resize the stickers and angle them)
I like that I’m able to create hex codes bc I have a LOT of color coded event categories and I need to be able to clock what type of event something is at a glance.
I DO wish that they had a resizing option on their drawing feature. (That would make writing things down ultra tidy, the chefs kiss to my planning little heart). Hopefully they’ll consider it.
I would like them to add in a holiday calendar, as trying to get mine to sync, is proving difficult and idk if I’ll be able to make it work, (I don’t want to have to do it all manually).
Also another nice feature would be if they incorporated (birthdays) auto synced from your contacts into the calendar, (similar to what the iPhones calendar does), and it would be prefect 🫶 (unless I’m missing something) all in all 4.5/5 starts for me

reviews.title: Free Trial is Sketchy! Buyer Beware!
reviews.text:
Free trial is a scam. 

First red flag: They make it difficult to cancel the free trial. You cannot do it in the app; and will need to go online.

Second red flag: after cancelling the message said it might take a few days to process my cancellation. ???? 
Thank goodness I cancelled during the first week and didn’t wait. Right? Wrong! 

Third red flag: A few days after cancelling, I received a confirmation email and was told my cancellation would be fully processed  after my free trial ended. 

It was going to take them well over a week to process my cancellation! I sent an email letting them know I would dispute any charges made and they immediately responded and cancelled my subscription.

reviews.title: Error Message After Error Message
reviews.text: This just doesn’t deliver. Any time I click in the agenda, error messages appear. Things have never synced properly. Essentially unusable. I’m very regretful that I spaced and allowed my subscription to renew.

reviews.title: Finally found one!
reviews.text: Love this!! It is a breeze to use, colorful, fun, and effective. Love the iPhone calendar merge. All the previous note-taking/agenda apps were way too complicated to use for a beginner. This app is a godsend and I will definitely invest in the subscription!

reviews.title: Great transition from paper to digital.
reviews.text: I was always a paper planner girl. But lugging around a paper planner in my purse was getting taxing. This planner made the transition much easier and honestly, I am spending a lot less even with the annual fee.
